newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Tsunami of IPOs hits, many stellar.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Tsunami of IPOs hits, many stellar.

text.p: A tsunami of initial public offerings hit the market on Friday, with about fifteen companies making their market debuts and most of them garnering big premiums.
Analysts said the resurgence in the IPO market, strong inflow into stock mutual funds, and "window-dressing" by portfolio managers fueled the initial gains.
Spanish language TV broadcaster Univision Communications Inc surged 33 percent, up 7-3/4 to 30-3/4 from its IPO price of 23 a share after its $188 million offering.
-- RockShox Inc, which makes suspension products for mountain bicycles, added 1/2 to 15-1/2 after its Wall Street debut.
-- Nitinol Medical Technologies Inc shares crept up 1/16 to 11-1/6. The offering of three million shares was led by underwriter JP Morgan & Co.

Nitinol Medical uses nitinol, an alloy with special characteristics, to make medical devices that can be transformed into the necessary shape once inside the body, making surgical procedures less invasive.

-- Wireless network system operator CellNet Data Systems rose as high as 21-1/4 before settling back to 20-1/8, just above its offering price of $20. The $100 million IPO of five million shares was underwritten by Morgan Stanley.
-- Leap Group Inc edged up 1/2 to 10-1/2. The Chicago company develops brand marketing campaigns. It offered four million shares which priced in the middle of its price range of $9-$11.
Previously, the company filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an IPO of about 3.5 million shares with a maximum price of $14 a share.
-- Nutritional Medical shares rose 3/8 from their IPO price of 3-7/8.
